_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Flight Flutter Test Report
summary: The Flight Flutter Test Report demonstrates compliance with flutter safety requirements (aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic) and provides a record of all flight flutter testing performed.
use_relationship:
The Flight Flutter Test Report will demonstrate compliance with flutter safety requirements (aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic) and provide a record of all flight flutter testing performed.
a. This Data Item Description is applicable to any contract for which flight flutter testing is required.
b. This DID contains the content, format, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
c. DI-MISC-81388A supersedes DI-MISC-81388.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Flight Flutter Test Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: This report shall contain the following:

children.title: Test point conditions including altitude, Mach number, equivalent airspeed in knots, and load factor, n, if in an accelerated condition.
Typical time traces of excitation and response.
Frequency and damping, g, of modes tracked or investigated.
Evaluation of test results by the flutter engineers.
For each configuration, a plot of altitude versus Mach number with curves of constant equivalent airspeed, the design limit speed envelope of the vehicle, and flutter test points investigated.
Plots of damping coefficient, g, and frequency versus airspeed for the modes investigated at a constant altitude and for a given test configuration.
